tools.name: list_items
tools.description: Everything 1211 prints on: each item's colours, sizes, print sizes, the pixels a picture needs to print well, and its price including US shipping.

tools.name: check_art
tools.description: Fetches a picture from a public link, or takes an attached file, stores it for a design and reports its size in pixels and how big it prints well. PNG, JPG, WEBP, GIF, HEIC, PDF or SVG, up to 25 MB. Pictures that are never ordered are deleted after 30 days.

tools.name: create_design
tools.description: Puts a picture (a public link, an upload id, an attached file or SVG markup) on an item and colour and returns the page where the person sees it, picks sizes and pays, with a picture of the result, how big each side prints, the price including US shipping, and any problems.
